common.tagline: The answer to building any system.
common.name: Name

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your account to continue.
login.twoFactorSubtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.locked: Account temporarily locked. Try again later.

signup.title: Create your company
signup.subtitle: Get started in seconds. Don't Panic.
signup.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. This is how your company shows up in links.
signup.slugTaken: That address is already taken. Pick another one.
signup.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
signup.acceptTerms: I have read and accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.
signup.acceptTermsRequired: You must accept the terms to continue.
signup.success: Company created! Check your email to confirm.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If that email exists, we've sent a reset link.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password.
reset.success: Password reset! You can sign in now.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}.
verify.resent: A new code is on its way.
verify.noEmail: Missing email address. Please sign up again.

captcha.required: Please confirm you are not a robot to continue.
captcha.failed: We could not validate the challenge. Try again.
captcha.unavailable: Verification is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.

dashboard.subtitle: Your base system is live. Build anything from here.

secure.title: Secure by default
secure.body: JWT, 2FA, CSRF, rate-limit and audit logging included.

i18n.title: Multilingual
i18n.body: pt-BR and en-US ready — switch with the flag.

swappable.title: Everything pluggable
swappable.body: Swap database, storage and email with one variable.

avatar.title: Profile photo
avatar.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 5MB.

email.title: Email
email.codeSent: We sent a code to the new address.

passwordSection.title: Change password
passwordSection.updated: Password updated. Please sign in again.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.enterCode: Enter the generated code to confirm.
twoFactor.backupHint: Store these somewhere safe. Each works once.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: Devices connected to your account.
sessions.revokeOthersConfirm: This ends all your other sessions. You'll stay signed in on this device.
sessions.revokedOthers: Signed out of all other devices.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.exportBody: Download everything we hold about you (LGPD/GDPR).
danger.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: Manage users and permissions.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete {email}? This revokes their sessions and marks the account deleted.

create.title: New user
create.subtitle: The account is created already verified.

session.advice: If this wasn’t you, change your password now — someone else may know it.

expired.title: Your session expired
expired.description: You were away long enough that we ended the session for safety. Sign in again to pick up where you left off.

signed-in-elsewhere.title: You signed in on another device
signed-in-elsewhere.description: Someone signed into this account on another device, so this session was ended.

reuse-detected.title: We ended your session for safety
reuse-detected.description: We detected suspicious use of this session’s credentials and ended every session on the account as a precaution.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page got lost in hyperspace.
notFound.marvin: Marvin: “I’d look for it, but I’ve got this terrible pain in all the diodes down my left side.”

serverError.title: Something broke
serverError.body: Don't Panic. We're already on it.
serverError.marvin: Marvin: “Here I am, brain the size of a planet, and they ask me to handle a 500.”

easter.consoleSubtitle: 42 — the answer to life, the universe, and your next system. 🛸
easter.konamiTitle: 🐬 So long, and thanks for all the fish.
easter.konamiDescription: Marvin: “Brain the size of a planet, and they ask me to render a toast.”

twoFactorPrompt.title: Secure your account with 2FA
twoFactorPrompt.body: Two-factor authentication adds a layer of security: even if your password leaks, nobody gets in without the code from your authenticator app.
twoFactorPrompt.requiredBody: This system requires two-factor authentication. Set it up below to access your account.

twoFactorSetup.scanBody: Use your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password…) and enter the generated code.
twoFactorSetup.backupBody: Store them somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose access to your app.

validation.passwordWeak: Min. 8 chars, with uppercase, lowercase and a number

blocked.title: Access blocked
blocked.body: Your company’s access is suspended. While it is, no screen in the system is available — not even to read.
blocked.contact: If you believe this is a mistake, contact support with your company’s name.

trial.daysLeft: Trial: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left.
trial.hint: After that, access is blocked until you pick a plan.

construction.title: Module under construction
construction.body: This part of the system does not exist yet. We would rather show an honest screen than fill the page with invented numbers — made-up data teaches you to distrust every other screen.

document.summaryDisclaimer: This summary exists to help you read and does not replace the text below, which is what counts.
document.highlightNotice: A clause limiting rights or liability — set apart as art. 54, §4 of the Brazilian Consumer Code requires.

page.incompleteBody: The company’s identifying details have not been filled in yet (look for ⚠ in the text). Without them this document identifies nobody and must not be published.
page.governingLaw: Governed by Brazilian law. The Portuguese version is the one that counts.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: The numbers for the whole platform.
overview.chartSubtitle: Companies created in the last 30 days.

tenants.title: Companies
tenants.subtitle: Every company on the platform.
tenants.reactivateConfirm: Give access back to {name} and all of its users?

form.subtitle: A blank limit means unlimited.
form.name: Name
form.limitsHint: Counters specific to your product, e.g. {"projects": 10}. Left blank, the current limits stay as they are.
form.featuresHint: Boolean flags, e.g. {"concurrentSessions": true}. Left blank, the current ones stay as they are.
form.invalid: Check the fields: some value is not accepted by the plan contract.
form.invalidJson: Limits and features must be a valid JSON object.

suspendDialog.title: Suspend {name}
suspendDialog.effect: Every user of that company loses access at once. The data stays stored.
suspendDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this company being suspended?
suspendDialog.reasonHint: It is recorded and is what explains the suspension later. At least 3 characters.

trialDialog.title: Extend trial
trialDialog.description: How many extra trial days for {name}?
trialDialog.daysHint: From 1 to 365 days, counted from the current end date.
